_about: The landing page (#home, the page you land on): hero, the four page cards, the study area and the About card. Built by js/landing.js. Images: a path in the repo (img/ or data/vegetation/). A card with "image": null shows the solid color of its page. The page color of a card comes from its "page" (the page id in content/pages.json, or "method"). "draft": true in the study area marks its sentences as not final: they are shown in grey.

studyArea.title: Study area
sentences: Sisal lies on the north coast of the Yucatán Peninsula, Mexico, where the coast is lined with lagoons and mangrove forest.
Mangroves protect the coast from storms, store carbon, and give shelter to fish, birds and the people who depend on them.
We compare an area with human intervention to an area without, to see what drives the changes we measure.

columns.label: Who
columns.text: TU Delft MDP × UNAM Sisal, 2026. A team of six from strategic product design, applied earth sciences and aerospace engineering.

columns.label: Data
columns.text: Landsat 5, 7, 8 and 9 (via Google Earth Engine), Sentinel-2 (base map), Global Mangrove Watch, ERA5 and ERA5-Land, HYCOM, satellite altimetry, and HURDAT2 (NOAA National Hurricane Center).

columns.label: Status
columns.text: Beta. Areas are mapped, not yet validated in the field.
